# Infinity Living Options (ILO)

> Indonesia's leading prefab modular light gauge steel (LGS) construction company. Factory-direct from Java. Villas, townhouses, and commercial buildings across Bali and Indonesia.

## Company Information

- **Website**: [https://www.ilo.net.au](https://www.ilo.net.au)
- **Email**: hello@ilo.net.au
- **WhatsApp**: +62 857-3988-8885
- **Location**: Bali, Indonesia (Factory in Java)
- **Founded**: Bali, Indonesia
- **Services**: Prefabricated modular light gauge steel construction; design-and-build villas; steel frame kits (supply or supply-and-erect) for builders and developers
- **Service Area**: Indonesia-wide (Bali, Lombok, Jakarta, Java)

## Key Facts

- LGS construction is 2-3x faster than conventional building methods
- 25-40% cost savings vs traditional brick/concrete construction
- 90% less site waste than conventional construction
- 50+ year structural lifespan with galvanized steel frames
- 100% recyclable steel — zero landfill
- Earthquake-resistant flexible steel framing
- Termite-proof, rot-proof, corrosion-resistant
- ASTM-certified steel with 230-340 MPa yield strength
- Own manufacturing factory in Java, Indonesia

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Light Gauge Steel (LGS) construction?**
LGS construction uses cold-formed galvanized steel profiles to create structural frames for buildings. It is a modern alternative to timber and concrete offering superior strength, speed, and sustainability.

**How much faster is LGS modular construction?**
LGS modular construction is typically 2-3x faster than conventional methods. Prefabricated frames are manufactured in our Java factory and assembled on-site in days rather than weeks.

**Is LGS construction earthquake resistant?**
Yes. LGS frames are lightweight and flexible, providing excellent seismic performance. The steel's ductility allows the structure to absorb and dissipate earthquake energy safely.

**How much does LGS construction cost in Indonesia?**
LGS construction is priced by build stage: an engineered frame-and-roof package starts around Rp 2.5 million per square metre, a weather-tight lockup shell around Rp 4 million, and a complete turnkey villa typically runs Rp 7-11 million per square metre depending on finish level. Total project costs are typically 25-40% less than conventional building methods in Indonesia when factoring in speed savings, reduced waste, and lower labour costs.

**Can LGS withstand Indonesia's tropical climate?**
Absolutely. Galvanized steel is resistant to corrosion, termites, rot, and mould. LGS frames are specifically suited for Indonesia's humid tropical environment and are backed by 50+ year structural warranties.

**What types of buildings can be built with LGS?**
LGS is suitable for villas, townhouses, multi-story residences (up to 3+ stories), commercial buildings, warehouses, offices, retail spaces, and hospitality buildings.

**Does ILO have its own factory?**
Yes. Infinity Living Options operates its own manufacturing facility in Java, Indonesia. All LGS frames are fabricated in-house using advanced CAD software and roll-forming technology, ensuring millimeter precision and consistent quality.

**Does ILO build prefab and modular homes in Bali?**
Yes. Infinity Living Options is a Bali-based, factory-direct builder of prefab, modular and light gauge steel (LGS) villas, townhouses and commercial buildings. ILO builds across Bali — including Canggu, Pererenan, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu and Sanur — as well as Lombok and the rest of Indonesia. Light gauge steel is especially well suited to Bali because galvanized steel is termite-proof and rot-proof in the tropical humidity, its flexible frames perform well in Bali's earthquake zone, and villas are built 2-3x faster so rental income starts sooner.

**Does ILO sell steel frame kits to other builders?**
Yes. Through Infinity Structural, ILO supplies engineered light gauge steel frame packages (wall panels, floor and roof trusses, fixings, erection drawings) to builders and developers in Bali and Lombok, either supply-only or supply-and-erect. A single-storey kit is about Rp 660,000 per m² of floor area ex-factory as a planning reference; two-storey, hybrid and installed packages are quoted per project. See https://www.ilo.net.au/structural
